description: FEROCIOUS, JAGUAR APPROVED CERTIFIED PRE-OWNED, NONSMOKER, PERFORMANCE UNLEASHED! The 2020 Jaguar F-PACE SVR takes everything appealing about a practical luxury SUV and adds a genuine supercharged V8 heart, creating something far more thrilling than its badge alone would suggest. This F-PACE was sold as a Jaguar Approved Certified Pre-Owned vehicle, meaning it passed a rigorous multi-point inspection process and carries manufacturer-backed coverage most used vehicles simply don't offer, plus a nonsmoker cabin that still presents beautifully. From behind the wheel, this F-PACE SVR still feels every bit as explosive and precise as the day it left the factory. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL Shoppers choose the F-PACE because it delivers genuine Jaguar driving dynamics and distinctive British design in a practical SUV body, standing apart from the more clinical feel of some German rivals. A well-balanced chassis and communicative steering give the F-PACE a genuinely engaging feel on a winding road, a trait that's rare among luxury SUVs built primarily around comfort. Buyers who step up to SVR specifically are chasing something even more?? -- Jaguar's Special Vehicle Operations division transforms the F-PACE into a genuine performance machine without sacrificing the everyday usability that made the standard model appealing in the first place. Jaguar's design language also plays a major role in the decision, with sculpted bodywork and a distinctive interior that feels genuinely different from the crossover crowd. It's a vehicle for buyers who want their SUV to have real personality. AUTOMOTIVE PRESS AND INDUSTRY RECOGNITION Automotive journalists have consistently praised the F-PACE SVR for delivering genuine sports-car theater and engagement from an SUV platform, frequently highlighting its snarling supercharged exhaust note and surprisingly agile handling as standout traits in the performance SUV segment. WARRANTY This F-PACE shows a low 75,985 miles on the odometer, and its Jaguar factory-backed coverage is still comfortably intact for the next owner. Remaining Transferable Factory Coverage: Jaguar Approved Certified Pre-Owned Limited Warranty Extends factory-backed coverage to 7 years or 100,000 miles from the original in-service date, whichever comes first, giving this Certified Pre-Owned F-PACE meaningful protection well beyond a typical used-vehicle purchase. An extended service plan may also be available for additional peace of mind beyond the factory-backed coverage above. STANDARD FEATURES SVR trim represents the top of the F-PACE lineup, built by Jaguar's Special Vehicle Operations division specifically to deliver a genuinely different ownership experience than any other F-PACE on the road. Bespoke sport seats, unique SVR badging, and a more aggressive exterior treatment throughout set this trim apart at a glance, while its firmer, purpose-tuned suspension makes clear this is no ordinary family SUV. INSTALLED OPTIONS Driver Assist Package Advanced driver-assistance technology bundled together to reduce fatigue and add genuine confidence on longer highway drives. Luxury Interior Package Elevates the cabin with premium materials and trim upgrades that make this SVR feel every bit as special inside as its performance suggests outside. Standalone Features 22'' 5 Split-Spoke Wheels with Gloss Black Finish A genuinely aggressive, staggered-look wheel design that reinforces this SVR's performance intentions at every angle. Head-Up Display Projects speed, navigation, and safety alerts directly into the driver's line of sight, keeping eyes on the road during spirited driving. Meridian Surround Sound System (825W) A genuinely powerful, audiophile-grade sound system that makes every drive, not just the loud ones, more enjoyable. Gloss Black Roof Rails Add a sleeker, more purposeful look to the roofline while retaining the practicality of a genuine roof-rail mounting point. Rear Seat Remote Release Levers Let a single person quickly fold the rear seats from the cargo area, making solo loading trips noticeably more convenient. MECHANICAL FEATURES A supercharged 5.0-liter V8 produces 550 horsepower and 502 lb-ft of torque, numbers that turn every on-ramp into an event and make this F-PACE one of the quickest SUVs in its class. NO PLUGGING IN NECESSARY -- this F-PACE runs on gasoline alone, with no charging cables or planning required, ever. The results are genuinely startling for a five-passenger SUV: 0-60 mph arrives in a manufacturer-estimated 4.1 seconds, a figure that puts this F-PACE in the company of dedicated sports cars. An 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive with a rear limited-slip differential keep that power planted and controllable, letting drivers access the SVR's full potential with genuine confidence rather than a handful of wheelspin. EXTERIOR FEATURES Finished in Eiger Grey Metallic, this F-PACE wears a sophisticated, purposeful shade that lets the SVR's aggressive bodywork and quad exhaust tips do the talking. The 22'' split-spoke wheels and gloss black roof rails add a genuinely cohesive, performance-focused look throughout the exterior. INTERIOR FEATURES Inside, an Ebony cabin with Light Oyster accents brings genuine visual contrast and a distinctly sporting feel to the cabin, elevated further by the Luxury Interior Package's premium materials throughout. Rear seat remote release levers add real everyday practicality for cargo loading, a thoughtful touch in a vehicle built primarily around performance. INFOTAINMENT & TECHNOLOGY The Meridian Surround Sound System's 825 watts of power bring genuine audiophile-level clarity and depth to every drive, while a built-in CD/DVD player rounds out the cabin's entertainment options for owners who still appreciate physical media. Jaguar's infotainment system keeps navigation and connectivity easily accessible from the driver's seat throughout. SAFETY FEATURES The Driver Assist Package brings a genuine layer of confidence-building technology to this F-PACE, helping reduce fatigue and catch potential hazards on longer highway stretches. A Head-Up Display keeps critical information directly in the driver's line of sight, backed by a full complement of airbags and Jaguar's inherently capable all-wheel-drive platform. ... and there's SO MUCH more! This F-PACE SVR brings together Jaguar Approved Certified Pre-Owned peace of mind, genuinely low mileage for its age, and a supercharged V8 that turns every drive into an occasion. Grocery-getter by design, apex predator by nature, this F-PACE SVR never really chooses one over the other.     • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians.     • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
    • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
    • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

Its bold front fascia, distinctive lighting, aerodynamic profile, sculpted bodywork, modern rear design, and contemporary wheel options give the Niro an appearance that stands apart from traditional economy cars.

This 2019 Mazda CX-5 Grand Touring is the kind of SUV that makes you wonder why youd spend thousands more for a luxury badge. Its stylish, comfortable, loaded with features, and still gives you the practicality you want from a compact SUV.

Its comfortable enough for road trips, practical enough for family duty, and stylish enough that youll actually enjoy seeing it in the driveway.

Leather. Bose. Moonroof. Great safety technology. Mazda driving dynamics.

If youre shopping RAV4, CR-V, Rogue, or Forester, drive this 2019 Mazda CX-5 Grand Touring before you make your decision.

description: Experience refined versatility with the 2019 Acura MDX in Lunar Silver Metallic, combining advanced safety, premium comfort, and responsive performance for your daily drive. Powered by a 3.5L V6 SOHC i-VTEC 24V engine paired with a smooth 9-speed automatic transmission featuring dual shift mode, this front-wheel-drive SUV delivers confident handling and efficient power. The brake-actuated limited-slip differential enhances traction, while performance tires front and rear provide a sporty edge. Step inside to find luxurious leather seats with heated front seating and adjustable lumbar support for both driver and passenger. The power-adjustable driver and passenger seats include memory settings, ensuring personalized comfort. The spacious cabin accommodates up to seven with a third-row seat and pass-through rear seating for added versatility. Safety is paramount with features like blind spot monitoring, lane departure warning, lane keeping assist, front collision mitigation, cross-traffic alert, and a comprehensive airbag system including knee and rear head airbags. Automatic headlights with high beams and LED lighting enhance visibility, complemented by rain-sensing wipers and heated, power-folding mirrors with integrated turn signals. Additional conveniences include a power liftgate, remote engine start, back-up camera, adaptive cruise control with steering assist, auto-dimming rearview mirror, and a premium sound system with HD radio and satellite radio capability. The interior is accented with woodgrain trim and a leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls, making every journey comfortable and connected.
